title: Check the student's notes on Oct 9 (about 27 min)
intro: The student listened to the Oct 9 lesson and wrote 80 notes about what the transcript or the app got wrong. For each one: play the moment, read his note, and tap whether he is right. One tap each; Undo is next to every answer. The lesson is not graded until you have looked at them.
what: 80 notes the student wrote on the Oct 9 lesson, each with its moment to play and the lines around it. Is he right? One tap each. About 27 minutes.
